narrative.intro: The federal government obligated $17B in contracts by NAICS for FY2027 to date. Facilities Support Services is the largest market with $3.9B in obligations. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) follows with $1.4B. Computer Systems Design Services and Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers each have $1.3B in obligations. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction has $1.2B in obligations. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences appears again with $1.1B in obligations. Other Computer Related Services accounts for $880M in obligations. Engineering Services has $607M in obligations. Security Guards and Patrol Services has $601M in obligations. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) has $460M in obligations. The list shows where FY2027 to date contract dollars are concentrated across NAICS categories and which industries are drawing the largest shares of the $17B total in obligations.

faq.q: What are the biggest federal contracting industries?
faq.a: Facilities Support Services is the biggest federal contracting industry, with $3.9B in obligations. Other leading industries include Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) with $1.4B, Computer Systems Design Services with $1.3B, Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers with $1.3B, and Commercial and Institutional Building Construction with $1.2B.
